one_liner: Nifty 50 tumbles 1.64% amid broad market sell-off and FII outflows.

drivers.title: FII Outflows
drivers.detail: FIIs sold Rs 5,027.36 Cr in cash market.

flows_line: FIIs were net sellers at Rs 5,027.36 Cr; DIIs bought Rs 4,301.18 Cr.
watch_next: Watch for BOE Gov Bailey's speech and UoM data releases tomorrow.
lesson_seeds: FII outflows can significantly impact market sentiment.
Rising VIX indicates increased market volatility.
Sectoral declines can drive broader market downturns.
Monitoring institutional flows is crucial for market insights.
